headlines.title: 워킹맘 고용률 66% 역대 최고 … 영유아 엄마 28%는 경력단절 겪어
headlines.summary: 경력단절 여성 비율 역대 최저치…"정부 돌봄정책 등 영향" 자녀 2명 엄마 고용률이 자녀 1명 제쳐…15∼54세 기혼여성 분석 유모차 끄는 시민들 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 올해 상반기 18세 미만 자녀를 키우는 일하는 여성, 워킹맘 고용률이 66%를 넘어 역대 가장 높은 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 증시 달러 수요에 ‘ 1300원 중반 ’ 서 멈춘 환율
headlines.summary: 1500원대→1300원 중반 뒤 정체 9~11월 달러 수요 하루 7.8억달러 7~8월 4.8억弗보다 2.4배 더 많아 外人 주식매도 비중 68→81% 커져 ‘반도체 달러’에도 원화 강세 상쇄 원/달러 환율이 6월 1528원(주간 종가 기준) 고점을 찍은 뒤 8월 1400원 수준으로 급락한 9~11월 1300원대 중반에서 횡보하고 있다.

headlines.title: 4분기 실적 기대감 ‘ 뚝 ’… 상장사 67% 영업익 전망 하향 조정
headlines.summary: 243곳 중 162곳 영업익 전망 하향 한전 등 5곳 흑자서 적자전환 예상 삼성생명·삼전닉스는 상향 전망 국내 상장사 10곳 중 6곳 이상이 4분기 실적 전망치 하향 조정을 피하지 못한 것으로 나타났다. 증권사들이 예상한 영업이익이 3개월 전보다 줄어든 기업이 전체의 67%에 달했다.

headlines.title: 카드론 막히고 리볼빙 금리 20 %… 불법사금융 내몰리는 ‘저신용자’
headlines.summary: 카드사들 신규 대출 중단 하면서 결제금 갚으려 고금리 찾을 우려 카드사들이 신규 카드론 취급을 사실상 멈추면서 취약차주의 자금 조달 여건이 악화하고 있다. 사용한 카드값을 다음 달로 넘기는 리볼빙 금리 역시 법정최고금리인 연 20%에 육박하자 저신용자들이 불법사금융으로 밀려날 수 있다는 우려가 나온다.

key_headlines.title: Korea Development Institute Raises Full-Year Growth Forecast to 3.8%, Next Year to 3.9%
key_headlines.summary: KDI upgraded South Korea's 2026 economic growth forecast from 3.2% to 3.8%, with 2027 growth projected at 3.9%, reflecting sustained momentum from AI investment and semiconductor sector expansion.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy shows mixed signals with upwardly revised growth forecasts contrasting sharply with weakening consumer sentiment. KDI raised full-year growth projections to 3.8% with expectations of 3.9% next year, driven primarily by semiconductor and AI-related investments. However, the K-shaped wealth polarization is deepening, with consumers feeling economic pressure despite macro indicators showing resilience. Regional disparities are evident as Gyeonggi Province apartment rents surge 40% while overall sentiment remains pessimistic. The government shifted its fiscal outlook from 'recovery trend' to 'steady growth,' reflecting confidence in structural tailwinds from advanced technology sectors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The U.S. employment situation remains solid with both jobless rates and unemployment insurance claims trending downward, maintaining its leading indicator status for future economic direction. Federal Reserve officials have reached consensus on the necessity for additional interest rate increases, with December's decision potentially ranging from 25 to 50 basis points depending on inflation data. Fed Chair emphasized the dual risks of AI investment failures potentially triggering recession and job displacement through automation, requiring comprehensive policy preparedness. Despite strong economic growth at 2.8% and low unemployment in the U.S., consumer sentiment deteriorated before the presidential election due to persistent cost-of-living concerns. South Korea's domestic consumption remains weak relative to its economic growth, suggesting uneven distribution of economic gains across income levels.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market showed volatility as the KOSPI and KOSDAQ traded mixed amid lingering concerns about AI investment profitability and capital raising challenges. South Korea's net external financial assets increased a record 280.7 billion dollars in Q3, driven primarily by currency appreciation effects on bond holdings despite a 19.3% plunge in KOSPI valuation. Foreign investors boosted stock sell-offs to 81% of their portfolio, with daily dollar demand reaching 780 million dollars, nearly 2.4 times higher than summer levels. The won-dollar rate stabilized around the mid-1,300 won range after falling from June's 1,528 won high, as capital outflows and semiconductor dollar demand offset won strength. Indices struggled as market participants weighed Fed rate hike prospects against disappointing AI profitability concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: Boston Dynamics' humanoid robot Atlas is entering semiconductor manufacturing for the first time outside automotive production, undergoing trials at GlobalFoundries as companies seek automation solutions for critical processes. South Korea's semiconductor industry defended itself against 'AI bubble' concerns, with Samsung asserting that neocloudcompanies represent only 8% of the market and pose limited threat to overall sector growth. The robotics sector continues advancing with Boston Dynamics' quadruped Spot achieving 99% mission success rates and experiencing expanded global factory deployment. Liquid cooling solutions for AI servers are becoming industry standard, with adoption rates expected to reach 53% by 2026 as high-density server heat management becomes critical. South Korean precision manufacturer Hongfu is expanding AI server liquid cooling market share domestically, positioning itself in the growing AI infrastructure supply chain.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment jeonse and monthly rental prices hit all-time highs, reflecting sustained demand surge among consumers deterred by soaring deposits and rents. Small-scale apartment complexes in Seoul's northern districts are attracting intense competition, with one complex recording 65.5-to-1 application ratios for 45-square-meter units as prospective homebuyers aggressively seek ownership amid rental market stress. Gyeonggi Province average apartment rents reached 1.06 million won, the national second-highest, with 200+ million won monthly rents surging 40% year-on-year as strict occupancy regulations restrict landlord-investor participation. Policy loans through Housing and Urban Development Funds now comprise 30% of all housing-related household credit, with fund-supported jeonse loans doubling in five years as government shifted emphasis from individual borrowers to public rental housing supply. BS Hanyang is expanding market presence by completing 7,700+ unit 'Sujahin' brand complexes in Sejong smart city projects, establishing itself as a major developer in government-designated new cities.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve maintains focus on additional interest rate increases with December's decision potentially reaching 50 basis points, as inflation data continues to surprise on the downside while employment remains resilient. Federal Reserve official Christopher Waller's proposal for a 50 basis point December hike paradoxically triggered long-term interest rate declines, illustrating market skepticism about aggressive tightening. APEC leadership competition between Trump and Xi Jinping is intensifying, with broader implications for regional trade dynamics and investment flows. American public opinion shows slight presidential preference shifts, with 51% favoring former President Obama compared to 52% viewing Trump most unfavorably among recent administrations. Trump administration emphasizes achievements including 20+ bilateral trade agreements and maintains opposition to global AI regulation, contrasting with multilateral regulatory approaches pursued by other nations.
sections.AI & Economy: Samsung Electronics countered AI bubble concerns by asserting neocloudcompanies represent merely 8% of market demand, defending the sector's fundamental growth trajectory against speculative criticism. Global AI infrastructure investment is entering a super-cycle phase extending beyond data centers into power grid and renewable energy infrastructure, with South Korea positioning itself to access $400 billion renewable energy market opportunities. AI liquid cooling solutions are becoming essential for next-generation data centers, with adoption expected to reach 53% globally by 2026 as server power densities and thermal loads intensify. Gartner forecasts AI infrastructure spending will surge 53% to $3.2 trillion in 2027, with memflation—price increases driven by high memory demand—accelerating capital expenditure growth among service providers. AI regulation's real variable increasingly lies with U.S. state governments rather than federal law, potentially impacting investment timing and geographic distribution for technology companies seeking infrastructure expansion.
sections.Others: Palo Alto Networks, the world's largest cybersecurity specialist, exceeded 2027 fiscal year expectations as heightened security demands drive strong earnings performance alongside strategic AI-focused acquisitions. Carlyle Group emphasized that private equity fund competitive advantage in the AI era depends on operational data quality rather than asset management scale, signaling strategy shifts among major alternative investors. Philippines President Marcos's 'chicken diplomacy' gained international attention after sending local fast-food chain Jollibee meals to Trump, who responded enthusiastically, highlighting unexpected diplomatic gestures in global relations. Nvidia employees expressed strong desire for Jensen Huang's return as CEO on internal platforms, with over half of respondents favoring his reinstatement despite current leadership structure. Gartner projects AI infrastructure expenditure will increase 53% to approximately $3.2 trillion in 2027, with memory price inflation and optimization server costs driving substantial capital deployment among technology service providers.
